cards.flavorText: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.

cards.flavorText: When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.

cards.name: Emolga

cards.flavorText: The energy made in its cheeks' electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.

cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Hold Still","cost":["Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"","text":"Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon."}]
cards.flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Dynamotor","text":"Once during your turn, you may attach a Basic Lightning Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

cards.name: Eelektross
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Thunder Fang","cost":["Lightning"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"60","text":"Flip a coin. cards.flavorText: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

cards.flavorText: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.

cards.flavorText: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Rollout","cost":["Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"10","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Best Punch","cost":["Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"60","text":"Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing."}]

cards.flavorText: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

cards.flavorText: As it flies, it scatters electricity around, so bird Pokémon keep their distance. That's why Emolga can keep all its food to itself.

cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Ad Hoc Shock","text":"When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: As Scyther fights more and more battles, its scythes become sharper and sharper. With a single slice, Scyther can fell a massive tree.

cards.flavorText: It travels by rolling down cliffs. If it falls into a river, it will explode with its last gasp.

cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Sun Energy","text":"Once during your turn, you may attach a Psychic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Lunatone.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

cards.name: Sunkern
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Seed Bomb","cost":["Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"20","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: It lives by drinking only dewdrops from under the leaves of plants. It is said that it eats nothing else.

cards.name: Baltoy
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Smack","cost":["Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"20","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Low Kick","cost":["Fighting","Fighting"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"50","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: It's exceedingly energetic, with enough stamina to keep running all through the night. Taking it for walks can be a challenging experience.

cards.name: Pancham

cards.flavorText: It chooses a Pangoro as its master and then imitates its master's actions. This is how it learns to battle and hunt for prey.

cards.name: Rockruff
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Invite Out","cost":["Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"","text":"Flip a coin. cards.flavorText: This Pokémon can bond very strongly with its Trainer, but it also has a habit of biting. Raising a Rockruff for a long time can be challenging.

cards.name: Lycanroc

cards.flavorText: This form of Lycanroc is reckless. It charges headlong at its opponents, attacking without any care about what injuries it might receive.

cards.flavorText: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.

cards.name: Liepard
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Fury Swipes","cost":["Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"40×","text":"Flip 3 coins. This attack does 40 damage for each heads."},{"name":"Claw Slash","cost":["Darkness","Darkness","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"110","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

cards.name: Krokorok
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Bite","cost":["Darkness"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"20","text":""},{"name":"Dredge Up","cost":["Colorless","Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"","text":"Discard the top 3 cards of your opponent's deck."}]
cards.flavorText: It buries some of its prey in the sand to use as emergency meals when its hunts are unsuccessful.

cards.name: Yanma
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Swoop Across","cost":["Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"","text":"This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)"},{"name":"Cutting Wind","cost":["Colorless","Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"70","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is quick to anger, and it has no problem using its prodigious strength to get its way. It lives for duels against Obstagoon.

cards.flavorText: It drifts in the ocean, blending in with floating seaweed. When other Pokémon come to feast on the seaweed, Skrelp feasts on them instead.

cards.flavorText: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

cards.flavorText: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

cards.flavorText: Bulky pincers account for one third of Scizor's body weight. A single swing of one of these pincers will crush a boulder completely.

cards.flavorText: It eats iron ore—and sometimes railroad tracks— to build up the steel armor that protects its body.

cards.flavorText: Lairon live in mountains brimming with spring water and iron ore, so these Pokémon often came into conflict with humans in the past.

cards.flavorText: Aggron has a horn sharp enough to perforate thick iron sheets. It brings down its opponents by ramming into them horn first.

cards.flavorText: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

cards.flavorText: Two Beldum have become stuck together via their own magnetic forces. With two brains, the resulting Metang has doubled psychic powers.

cards.flavorText: It uses river stones to maintain the cutting edges of the blades covering its body. These sharpened blades allow it to bring down opponents.

cards.flavorText: It uses river stones to maintain the cutting edges of the blades covering its body. These sharpened blades allow it to bring down opponents.

cards.flavorText: An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.

cards.flavorText: It signals its emotions with its melodies. Scientists are studying these melodic patterns.

cards.flavorText: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

cards.name: Lapras

cards.flavorText: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Wave Veil","text":"Prevent all damage done to your Benched Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.

cards.name: Electivire

cards.flavorText: It has an electrical organ on its chest. While generating electricity, it fills its surroundings with what sounds like the strumming of a bass guitar.

cards.flavorText: Its DNA is said to contain the genetic codes of all Pokémon, so it can use all kinds of techniques.

cards.flavorText: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

cards.flavorText: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Princess's Curtain","text":"As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, whenever your opponent plays a Supporter card from their hand, prevent all effects of that card done to your Benched Basic Pokémon.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

cards.flavorText: Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates itself with them. For some reason, flowers won't wither once they're attached to a Comfey.

cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Sun Energy","text":"Once during your turn, you may attach a Psychic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Lunatone.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

cards.flavorText: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Giga Magnet","text":"Once during your turn, you may look at the top 6 cards of your deck and attach any number of Metal Energy cards you find there to your Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: Some say that Magnezone receives signals from space via the antenna on its head and that it's being controlled by some mysterious being.

cards.name: Altaria

cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Tempting Tune","text":"Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, shuffle your deck, then put that card on top of it.","type":"Ability"}]

cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Red Assist","text":"Once during your turn, you may attach a Psychic Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Latios.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.

cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Metal Lodging","text":"Prevent all damage done to each of your Basic Pokémon that has any Metal Energy attached by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon V.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy— it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

cards.flavorText: It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.

cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Mysterious Nest","text":"Colorless Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) have no Weakness.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: When it sees a person, it digs a hole with its tail to make its escape. If you happen to find one, consider yourself lucky.

cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Miracle Body","text":"Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon V.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: Miltank produces highly nutritious milk, so it's been supporting the lives of people and other Pokémon since ancient times.

cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Industrious Incisors","text":"Once during your turn, you may draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand.","type":"Ability"}]

cards.name: Swablu

cards.flavorText: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

cards.flavorText: If it finds bad children who won't listen to their parents, it will spirit them away—or so it's said.

cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Carefree Countenance","text":"As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.

cards.name: Pikachu

cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Pika Dash","text":"If this Pokémon has any Energy attached, it has no Retreat Cost.","type":"Ability"}]

cards.flavorText: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.

cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Flare","cost":["Fire"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"30","text":""},{"name":"Lost Volcano","cost":["Fire","Fire","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"220","text":"Put all Energy attached to this Pokémon in the Lost Zone."}]
cards.flavorText: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.

cards.name: Torkoal
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Stampede","cost":["Fire","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"30","text":""},{"name":"Flamethrower","cost":["Fire","Colorless","Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":4,"damage":"130","text":"Discard an Energy from this Pokémon."}]
cards.flavorText: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

cards.name: Litwick
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Kindling Panic","cost":["Fire"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"","text":"Discard the top card of your opponent's deck."}]
cards.flavorText: The flame on its head keeps its body slightly warm. This Pokémon takes lost children by the hand to guide them to the spirit world.

cards.name: Lampent
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Flickering Glow","cost":["Fire"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"20","text":"Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon."}]
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon appears just before someone passes away, so it's feared as an emissary of death.

cards.name: Chandelure
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Heat Blast","cost":["Fire","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"90","text":""}]
cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Mountain Roasting","text":"When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may discard the top 3 cards of your opponent's deck.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon haunts dilapidated mansions. It sways its arms to hypnotize opponents with the ominous dancing of its flames.

cards.name: Delphox V

cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Singe","cost":["Fire"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"","text":"Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned."}]
cards.flavorText: This hot-blooded Pokémon is filled with curiosity. When it gets angry or starts fighting, its short mane gets hot.

cards.name: Pyroar
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Fire Fang","cost":["Fire","Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"90","text":"Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned."}]
cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Scorching Aura","text":"During Pokémon Checkup, put 4 damage counters on your opponent's Burned Pokémon instead of 2.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: The temperature of its breath is over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, but Pyroar doesn't use it on its prey. This Pokémon prefers to eat raw meat.

cards.name: Vileplume
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Mega Drain","cost":["Grass","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"50","text":"Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon."},{"name":"Allergy Storm","cost":["Grass","Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"90","text":"Flip a coin. cards.flavorText: It has the world's largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

cards.name: Poliwag

cards.flavorText: For Poliwag, swimming is easier than walking. The swirl pattern on its belly is actually part of the Pokémon's innards showing through the skin.

cards.name: Poliwhirl
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Light Punch","cost":["Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"30","text":""},{"name":"Double Smash","cost":["Water","Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"50×","text":"Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads."}]
cards.flavorText: Staring at the swirl on its belly causes drowsiness. This trait of Poliwhirl's has been used in place of lullabies to get children to go to sleep.

cards.name: Politoed
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Lordly Songleader","cost":["Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"10+","text":"If Poliwag is on your Bench, this attack does 60 more damage. If Poliwhirl is on your Bench, this attack does 90 more damage. If Poliwrath is on your Bench, this attack does 120 more damage."},{"name":"Hydro Splash","cost":["Water","Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"100","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: At nightfall, these Pokémon appear on the shores of lakes. They announce their territorial claims by letting out cries that sound like shouting.

cards.name: Seel

cards.flavorText: Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don't bother it at all, but it gets tired pretty easily in warm waters.

cards.name: Dewgong
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Swim Freely","cost":["Water"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"10","text":"Flip a coin. cards.flavorText: It sunbathes on the beach after meals. The rise in its body temperature helps its digestion.

cards.name: Horsea
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Reverse Thrust","cost":["Water"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"10","text":"Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon."}]
cards.flavorText: Horsea makes its home in oceans with gentle currents. If this Pokémon is under attack, it spits out pitch-black ink and escapes.

cards.name: Seadra
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Swim Freely","cost":["Water"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"10","text":"Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon."},{"name":"Hydro Jet","cost":["Water"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"","text":"This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)"}]
cards.flavorText: It's the males that raise the offspring. While Seadra are raising young, the spines on their backs secrete thicker and stronger poison.

cards.name: Kingdra
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Hydro Splash","cost":["Water","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"130","text":""}]
cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Seething Currents","text":"Once during your turn, you may have either player shuffle their hand and put it on the bottom of their deck. If that player put any cards on the bottom of their deck in this way, they draw 4 cards.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: With the arrival of a storm at sea, this Pokémon will show itself on the surface. When a Kingdra and a Dragonite meet, a fierce battle ensues.

cards.name: Luvdisc
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Matching Look","cost":["Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"","text":"Each player reveals the top 2 cards of their deck, then draws those cards."},{"name":"Tackle","cost":["Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"30","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: Luvdisc makes its home in coral reefs in warm seas. It especially likes sleeping in the space between Corsola's branches.

cards.name: Shellos
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Rain Splash","cost":["Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"10","text":""},{"name":"Surf","cost":["Colorless","Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"30","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: There's speculation that its appearance is determined by what it eats, but the truth remains elusive.

cards.name: Paras
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Absorb","cost":["Grass","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"20","text":"Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon."}]
cards.flavorText: The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are controlling the bug. Even if the bug bugs the mushrooms, they tell it to bug off.

cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Oceanic Accompaniment","text":"As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Water Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon that has the Swim Freely attack.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: It lures in prey with its shining tail fins. It stays near the surface during the day and moves to the depths when night falls.

cards.name: Lumineon

cards.flavorText: They traverse the deep waters as if crawling over the seafloor. The fantastic lights of its fins shine like stars in the night sky.

cards.flavorText: One is likely to encounter this Pokémon while out in the snow. There are stories of Snover appearing in human settlements but doing no harm—rather, they bond with the children.

cards.flavorText: If it sees any packs of Darumaka going after Snover, it chases them off, swinging its sizable arms like hammers.

cards.name: Hisuian Basculin

cards.flavorText: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

cards.name: Hisuian Basculegion

cards.flavorText: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

cards.flavorText: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Lost Provisions","text":"If you have 4 or more cards in the Lost Zone, ignore all Energy in this Pokémon's attack costs.","type":"Ability"}]

cards.flavorText: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It's also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it wants, it takes by force.

cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Pika Dash","text":"If this Pokémon has any Energy attached, it has no Retreat Cost.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

cards.flavorText: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

cards.flavorText: It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.

cards.flavorText: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

cards.name: Wurmple

cards.flavorText: It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.

cards.name: Eelektrik

cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Ad Hoc Shock","text":"When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

cards.name: Eelektross
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Coil","cost":["Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"10","text":"During your next turn, this Pokémon's attacks do 120 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance)."},{"name":"Extreme Current","cost":["Lightning","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"160","text":"Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon."}]
cards.flavorText: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Wonder Storm","cost":["Colorless","Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"20×","text":"This attack does 20 damage for each Psychic Energy attached to all of your Pokémon."}]
cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Moon-Watching Party","text":"Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, for each of your Benched Clefairy, you may search your deck for a Psychic Energy card and attach it to that Clefairy. Then, shuffle your deck.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: It can be found in quiet mountain areas on a full moon's night. Its dancing and its tiny, faintly glowing wings confer upon it a lovely fairylike quality.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Moon Impact","cost":["Psychic","Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"90","text":""}]
cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Spirit Charm","text":"All of your Pokémon take 30 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Dragon Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance). You can't apply more than 1 Spirit Charm Ability at a time.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Furtive Drop","cost":["Psychic"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"","text":"Put 1 damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon."}]
cards.flavorText: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Cursed Drop","cost":["Psychic"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"","text":"Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like."}]
cards.flavorText: This frightful, malevolent spirit can glide through walls, appearing wherever it likes. According to rumor, victims of a Haunter's lick will wither to death day by day.

cards.name: Gengar
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Screaming Circle","cost":["Psychic"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"","text":"Put 2 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon."}]
cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Netherworld Gate","text":"Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in your discard pile, you may put it onto your Bench. If you do, put 3 damage counters on this Pokémon.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: On the night of a full moon, if shadows move on their own and laugh, it must be Gengar's doing.

cards.name: Mr. Mime
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Pound","cost":["Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"20","text":""},{"name":"Tricky Slap","cost":["Psychic","Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"90","text":"You and your opponent play Rock-Paper-Scissors until someone wins. If you win, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon."}]
cards.flavorText: The behavior of this clown-like Pokémon reminds one of pantomime. It creates invisible walls using a force emitted from its fingertips.

cards.name: Jynx
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Alluring Dance","cost":["Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"","text":"Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. The new Active Pokémon is now Confused."},{"name":"Super Psy Bolt","cost":["Psychic","Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"80","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: Its strange cries sound like human language. There are some musicians who compose songs for Jynx to sing.

cards.name: Radiant Gardevoir
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Psychic","cost":["Psychic","Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"70+","text":"This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon."}]
cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Loving Veil","text":"All of your Pokémon take 20 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon V (after applying Weakness and Resistance).","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.
cards.rulesJson: ["Radiant Pokémon Rule: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck."]

cards.name: Silcoon
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Entangling String","cost":["Grass"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"","text":"Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't attack."},{"name":"Ram","cost":["Grass","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"30","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: It drinks dew that collects on its silk and waits for evolution. Its hard cocoon repels attacks.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Scratch","cost":["Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"20","text":""},{"name":"Lost Mine","cost":["Psychic"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"","text":"You can use this attack only if you have 10 or more cards in the Lost Zone. Put 12 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like."}]
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is feared. When its gemstone eyes begin to glow with a sinister shine, it's believed that Sableye will steal people's spirits away.

cards.name: Mawile
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Tempting Trap","cost":["Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"","text":"During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat. During your next turn, the Defending Pokémon takes 90 more damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance)."},{"name":"Bite","cost":["Psychic","Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"90","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.

cards.name: Shuppet
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Tongue Slap","cost":["Psychic","Psychic"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"30","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: There's a proverb that says, "Shun the house where Shuppet gather in the growing dusk."

cards.name: Banette
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Spooky Shot","cost":["Psychic","Psychic"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"50","text":""}]
cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Puppet Offering","text":"Once during your turn, you may put a Supporter card from your discard pile into your hand. If you do, put this Pokémon in the Lost Zone. (Discard all attached cards.)","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.

cards.name: Cresselia
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Moonglow Reverse","cost":["Psychic"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"","text":"Move 2 damage counters from each of your Pokémon to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon."},{"name":"Lunar Blast","cost":["Psychic","Psychic","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"110","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: Those who sleep holding Cresselia's feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

cards.name: Hisuian Zorua
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Collect","cost":[],"convertedEnergyCost":0,"damage":"","text":"Draw a card."},{"name":"Mumble","cost":["Psychic"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"10","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

cards.name: Hisuian Zoroark
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Doom Curse","cost":[],"convertedEnergyCost":0,"damage":"","text":"At the end of your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon will be Knocked Out."},{"name":"Call Back","cost":["Psychic"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"","text":"Put a card from your discard pile into your hand."}]
cards.flavorText: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.

cards.name: Inkay
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Fickle Attack","cost":["Psychic"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"30","text":"Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing."}]
cards.flavorText: It spins while making its luminescent spots flash. These spots allow it to communicate with others by using different patterns of light.

cards.name: Malamar
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Synchro Kinesis","cost":["Psychic"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"30+","text":"Each player reveals their hand. If a card in your opponent's hand has the same name as a card in your hand, this attack does 90 more damage."},{"name":"Psychic Sphere","cost":["Psychic","Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"80","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: Gazing at its luminescent spots will quickly induce a hypnotic state, putting the observer under Malamar's control.

cards.name: Comfey
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Spinning Attack","cost":["Psychic","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"30","text":""}]
cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Flower Selecting","text":"Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may look at the top 2 cards of your deck and put 1 of them into your hand. Put the other card in the Lost Zone.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates itself with them. For some reason, flowers won't wither once they're attached to a Comfey.

cards.name: Beautifly
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Mega Drain","cost":["Grass","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"70","text":"Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon."}]
cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Stoked Straw","text":"Once during your turn, you may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey's fluids.

cards.name: Mimikyu
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Perplex","cost":["Psychic"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"","text":"Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused."},{"name":"Worst Gift","cost":["Psychic","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"10×","text":"This attack does 10 damage for each damage counter on all of your opponent's Pokémon."}]
cards.flavorText: It wears a rag fashioned into a Pikachu costume in an effort to look less scary. Unfortunately, the costume only makes it creepier.

cards.name: Spectrier
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Night Footsteps","cost":["Psychic"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"","text":"Choose 2 of your opponent's Pokémon and put 2 damage counters on each of them."},{"name":"Phantom Strike","cost":["Psychic","Psychic","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"120","text":"During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Phantom Strike."}]
cards.flavorText: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn't use its sense of sight. Spectrier's kicks are said to separate soul from body.

cards.name: Enamorus V
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Blossom Tail","cost":["Psychic","Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"100","text":"Attach up to 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like."}]
cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Guardian of Love","text":"Prevent all effects of your opponent's Pokémon's Abilities done to each of your Pokémon that has any Psychic Energy attached, except any Enamorus V.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.rulesJson: ["V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards."]

cards.name: Hisuian Growlithe
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Singe","cost":[],"convertedEnergyCost":0,"damage":"","text":"Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned."}]
cards.flavorText: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

cards.name: Hisuian Arcanine
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Very Vulnerable","cost":[],"convertedEnergyCost":0,"damage":"10+","text":"If you have no cards in your hand, this attack does 150 more damage."},{"name":"Sharp Fang","cost":["Fighting","Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"100","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

cards.name: Poliwrath
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Split Spiral Punch","cost":["Water"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"60","text":"Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused."},{"name":"Splash Loop","cost":["Water","Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"160","text":"Put 2 Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand."}]
cards.flavorText: Its body is solid muscle. When swimming through cold seas, Poliwrath uses its impressive arms to smash through drift ice and plow forward.

cards.name: Machop
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Punch","cost":["Fighting"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"20","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it's the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

cards.name: Machoke
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Strength","cost":["Fighting"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"30","text":""},{"name":"Seismic Toss","cost":["Fighting","Fighting"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"50","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: A sturdy creature boasting a robust physique and boundless stamina. Loves training above all else and voluntarily assists with tasks such as construction and clearing land.

cards.name: Machamp
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Strong-Arm Lariat","cost":["Fighting","Fighting"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"100+","text":"You may do 100 more damage. If you do, during your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack."}]
cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Crisis Muscles","text":"If your opponent has 3 or fewer Prize cards remaining, this Pokémon gets +150 HP.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

cards.name: Rhyhorn
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Take Down","cost":["Fighting","Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"70","text":"This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself."}]
cards.flavorText: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging tackles.

cards.name: Cascoon
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Harden","cost":["Grass"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"","text":"During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks if that damage is 60 or less."},{"name":"Rolling Tackle","cost":["Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"20","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.

cards.name: Rhydon
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Horn Drill","cost":["Fighting"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"30","text":""},{"name":"Take Down","cost":["Fighting","Colorless","Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":4,"damage":"120","text":"This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself."}]
cards.flavorText: It begins walking on its hind legs after evolution. It can punch holes through boulders with its horn.

cards.name: Rhyperior
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Geo Cannon","cost":["Fighting"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"50+","text":"Discard the top card of your deck. If that card is an Energy card, this attack does 100 more damage, and attach that card to this Pokémon."},{"name":"Rocky Tackle","cost":["Fighting","Colorless","Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":4,"damage":"180","text":"This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself."}]
cards.flavorText: It can load up to three projectiles per arm into the holes in its hands. What launches out of those holes could be either rocks or Roggenrola.

cards.name: Aerodactyl V
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Bite","cost":["Fighting","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"40","text":""},{"name":"Rock Crush","cost":["Fighting","Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"120","text":"Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon."}]
cards.rulesJson: ["V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards."]

cards.name: Aerodactyl VSTAR
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Lost Dive","cost":["Fighting","Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"240","text":"Put the top 3 cards of your deck in the Lost Zone."},{"name":"Ancient Star","cost":["Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"","text":"Until this Pokémon leaves play, it gains an Ability that has the effect \"Your opponent's Pokémon V in play, except any Aerodactyl VSTAR, have no Abilities.\" (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)"}]
cards.rulesJson: ["VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards."]

cards.name: Sudowoodo
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Joust","cost":["Fighting"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"20","text":"Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon."},{"name":"Impound","cost":["Fighting","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"50","text":"During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat."}]
cards.flavorText: Though it pretends to be a tree, it fails to fool even children. To the touch, its body feels more like rock than tree bark. Sudowoodo's extreme aversion to water merits special note.

cards.name: Gligar
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Cyclone Pincers","cost":["Fighting"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"10×","text":"Flip 4 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads."}]
cards.flavorText: It flies straight at its target's face, then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

cards.name: Gliscor
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Hurricane Shock","cost":["Fighting","Fighting"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"50×","text":"Flip 4 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads. If at least 2 of them are heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed."}]
cards.flavorText: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey... Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

cards.name: Makuhita
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Fake Out","cost":["Fighting","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"20","text":"Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed."}]
cards.flavorText: There's a rumor of a traditional recipe for stew that Trainers can use to raise strong Makuhita.

cards.name: Hariyama
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Shove","cost":["Fighting","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"40","text":"Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed."},{"name":"Muscular Slap","cost":["Fighting","Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"100","text":"This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance."}]
cards.flavorText: Hariyama that are big and fat aren't necessarily strong. There are some small ones that move nimbly and use moves skillfully.

cards.name: Meditite
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Focus Fist","cost":["Fighting"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"30","text":"Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing."}]
cards.flavorText: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

cards.name: Ledyba
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Collect","cost":["Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"","text":"Draw a card."},{"name":"Punch","cost":["Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"20","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: These very cowardly Pokémon join together and use Reflect to protect their nest.

cards.name: Tynamo
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Tiny Charge","cost":["Lightning"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"10","text":""}]
cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Levitate","text":"If this Pokémon has any Energy attached, it has no Retreat Cost.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: One alone can emit only trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

cards.name: Cutiefly
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Flap","cost":["Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"10","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: An opponent's aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent's next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.

cards.name: Bewear
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Split Spiral Punch","cost":["Fighting","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"40","text":"Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused."},{"name":"Strength","cost":["Fighting","Fighting","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"130","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.

cards.name: Pangoro
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Knocking Hammer","cost":["Darkness","Darkness","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"90","text":"Discard the top card of your opponent's deck."},{"name":"Shakedown","cost":["Darkness","Darkness","Darkness","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":4,"damage":"150","text":"Discard a random card from your opponent's hand."}]
cards.flavorText: Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.

cards.name: Drampa
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Corkscrew Punch","cost":["Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"30","text":""},{"name":"Berserk","cost":["Water","Fighting"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"70+","text":"If your Benched Pokémon have any damage counters on them, this attack does 90 more damage."}]
cards.flavorText: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it's angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

cards.name: Smeargle
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Live Painting","cost":["Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"30+","text":"Reveal any number of basic Energy cards from your hand. This attack does 30 more damage for each type of basic Energy you revealed in this way."}]
cards.flavorText: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

cards.name: Rowlet
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Wind Shard","cost":["Colorless","Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"","text":"This attack does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)"}]
cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Sky Circus","text":"If you played Bird Keeper from your hand during this turn, ignore all Energy in this Pokémon's attack costs.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: At a distance, it launches its sharp feathers while flying about. If the enemy gets too close, Rowlet switches tactics and delivers vicious kicks.

cards.name: Gossifleur
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Blot","cost":["Grass"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"10","text":"Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon."}]
cards.flavorText: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Warm Up","cost":["Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"","text":"Search your deck for a Fire Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck."},{"name":"Combustion","cost":["Fire","Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"30","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: Extremely loyal, it will fearlessly bark at any opponent to protect its own Trainer from harm.

cards.name: Victini
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Victory Dive","cost":["Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"30","text":"You may search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck."}]
cards.flavorText: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Wintry Call","cost":["Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"","text":"Search your deck for up to 2 Melony cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck."},{"name":"Icy Wind","cost":["Water","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"50","text":"Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep."}]
cards.flavorText: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Energize","cost":["Lightning"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"","text":"Attach a Lightning Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon."},{"name":"Electro Ball","cost":["Lightning","Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"30","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: When Pikachu meet, they'll touch their tails together and exchange electricity through them as a form of greeting.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Electro Ball","cost":["Lightning"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"10","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Electro Ball","cost":["Lightning","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"50","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

cards.name: Bulbasaur
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Vine Whip","cost":["Grass"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"10","text":""},{"name":"Razor Leaf","cost":["Grass","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"20","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this Pokémon is born. The seed slowly grows larger.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Flare Blitz","cost":["Fire","Fire","Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":4,"damage":"170","text":"Discard all Fire Energy from this Pokémon."}]
cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Burn Brightly","text":"Each basic Fire Energy attached to your Pokémon provides FireFire Energy. You can't apply more than 1 Burn Brightly Ability at a time.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

cards.name: Radiant Charizard
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Combustion Blast","cost":["Fire","Colorless","Colorless","Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":5,"damage":"250","text":"During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Combustion Blast."}]
cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Excited Heart","text":"This Pokémon's attacks cost Colorless less for each Prize card your opponent has taken.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.
cards.rulesJson: ["Radiant Pokémon Rule: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck."]

cards.name: Moltres
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Fire Wing","cost":["Fire","Fire","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"110","text":""}]
cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Flare Symbol","text":"Your Basic Fire Pokémon's attacks, except any Moltres, do 10 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: It's one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.

cards.name: Numel
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Tackle","cost":["Fire","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"20","text":""},{"name":"Stomp","cost":["Fire","Fire","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"50+","text":"Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 50 more damage."}]
cards.flavorText: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.

cards.name: Camerupt
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Split Bomb","cost":["Fire","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"","text":"This attack does 50 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)"},{"name":"Heat Blast","cost":["Fire","Fire","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"120","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: If angered, the humps on its back erupt in a shower of molten lava. It lives in the craters of volcanoes.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Water Gun","cost":["Water"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"20","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

cards.name: Wartortle
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Water Gun","cost":["Water"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"30","text":""},{"name":"Hydro Pump","cost":["Colorless","Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"50+","text":"This attack does 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon."}]
cards.flavorText: It is recognized as a symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.

cards.name: Blastoise
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Hydro Pump","cost":["Colorless","Colorless","Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":4,"damage":"90+","text":"This attack does 30 more damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon."}]
cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Vitality Spring","text":"Once during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 6 Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

cards.name: Radiant Blastoise
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Torrential Cannon","cost":["Water","Water","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"170","text":"During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Torrential Cannon."}]
cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Pump Shot","text":"You must discard a Water Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.
cards.rulesJson: ["Radiant Pokémon Rule: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck."]

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Hold Still","cost":["Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"","text":"Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon."},{"name":"Ideal Fishing Day","cost":["Water"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"","text":"Put an Item card from your discard pile into your hand."}]
cards.flavorText: Slow-witted and oblivious, this Pokémon won't feel any pain if its tail gets eaten. It won't notice when its tail grows back, either.

cards.name: Ivysaur
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Summoning Aroma","cost":["Grass"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"","text":"Search your deck for up to 2 Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck."},{"name":"Razor Leaf","cost":["Grass","Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"60","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

cards.flavorText: Swinub excels at sniffing out mushrooms buried beneath grass or snow. Since ancient times, the people of Hisui have often relied upon this skill.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon can be spotted in wall paintings from as far back as 10,000 years ago. For a while, it was thought to have gone extinct.

cards.flavorText: This calm and gentle Pokémon swims gracefully through the sea. After building speed, it can leap out of the water. It is often misidentified as a bird Pokémon due to this behavior.

cards.flavorText: Makes its home in swamps with murky water. The poor visibility hides this Pokémon from predators, and the slime on its body makes grasping it difficult.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name "scalchop.".

cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Razor Shell","cost":["Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"20+","text":"Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage."}]
cards.flavorText: Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.

cards.name: Hisuian Basculin

cards.flavorText: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

cards.name: Hisuian Basculegion

cards.flavorText: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

cards.flavorText: It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

cards.flavorText: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.

cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Voice of Happiness","text":"When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may heal 30 damage from your Active Pokémon.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

cards.name: Togekiss

cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Shine of Happiness","text":"When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may heal 90 damage from your Active Pokémon.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they've hardly been seen at all.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Mumble","cost":["Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"10","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: It conceals itself in darkness, sending chills up travelers' spines with its childlike weeping. As it observes the frightened travelers with glee, the red orbs upon its chest let off an eerie light.

cards.name: Mismagius
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Ominous Prose","cost":["Psychic"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"","text":"Your opponent reveals their hand. cards.flavorText: Its muttered curses can cause awful headaches or terrifying visions that torment others.

cards.name: Yanma
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Speed Dive","cost":["Grass"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"20","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: Its frail wings are so thin that one can see clear through them. However, during flight these wings exhibit the power to churn air with force enough to launch a house skyward.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Teleportation Burst","cost":["Psychic"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"10","text":"Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon."}]
cards.flavorText: Tends to prefer people with a chipper disposition to those who are gloomy, but it has shown no discrimination with regard to age or gender. Needs more research.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Teleportation Burst","cost":["Psychic"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"30","text":"Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon."}]
cards.flavorText: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

cards.name: Gallade
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Swirling Slice","cost":["Psychic","Colorless","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"160","text":"Move an Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon."}]
cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Buddy Catch","text":"Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: True to its honorable-warrior image, it uses the blades on its elbows only in defense of something or someone.

cards.name: Drifloon
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Triple Spin","cost":["Psychic"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"10×","text":"Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads."}]
cards.flavorText: Said to lure away young children and carry them off to the afterlife. Some whisper that Drifloon are formed of reincarnated human souls, but these rumors are as yet unconfirmed.

cards.name: Drifblim
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Spooky Balloon","cost":["Psychic"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"50","text":"Put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon."}]
cards.flavorText: Some say this Pokémon is a collection of souls burdened with regrets, silently drifting through the dusk.

cards.name: Uxie
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Wise Guidance","cost":["Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"","text":"Search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck."},{"name":"Psyshot","cost":["Psychic"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"20","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: It is said that its emergence gave humans the intelligence to improve their quality of life.

cards.name: Mesprit
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Zen Headbutt","cost":["Psychic","Psychic"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"30","text":""}]
cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Mental Shroud","text":"If you have Uxie and Azelf in play, each of your Pokémon has no Weakness.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: It sleeps at the bottom of a lake. Its spirit is said to leave its body to fly on the lake's surface.

cards.name: Azelf
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Mind Bend","cost":["Psychic"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"30","text":"Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused."}]
cards.flavorText: It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf all came from the same egg.

cards.name: Diancie
cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Spike Draw","cost":["Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":1,"damage":"20","text":"Draw 2 cards."}]
cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Princess's Curtain","text":"As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, whenever your opponent plays a Supporter card from their hand, prevent all effects of that card done to your Benched Basic Pokémon.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

cards.name: Wyrdeer

cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Hurried Gait","text":"Once during your turn, you may draw a card.","type":"Ability"}]
cards.flavorText: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

cards.name: Yanmega

cards.flavorText: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

cards.name: Hisuian Growlithe

If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks."},{"name":"Bite","cost":["Fighting","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"30","text":""}]
cards.flavorText: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

cards.flavorText: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

cards.attacksJson: [{"name":"Revenge Buster","cost":["Fighting","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":2,"damage":"80+","text":"If your Benched Pokémon have any damage counters on them, this attack does 140 more damage."},{"name":"G-Max Chi Strike","cost":["Fighting","Fighting","Colorless"],"convertedEnergyCost":3,"damage":"240","text":"During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use G-Max Chi Strike."}]

cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Vamoose","text":"If this Pokémon has any damage counters on it, it has no Retreat Cost.","type":"Ability"}]

cards.flavorText: The faint scent that emanates from its full blossom entices bug Pokémon to it.

cards.abilitiesJson: [{"name":"Delicious Aroma","text":"Once during your turn, you may flip a coin. If heads, switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Basic Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.","type":"Ability"}]
